description: Calculate the final price after a discount, with support for a second discount and a coupon amount. See the final price, total savings and effective savings percentage.

faqs.a: Final price = original x (1 - discount/100). A second discount applies to the already-discounted price, then any coupon amount is subtracted.
faqs.q: How is the final price calculated?

faqs.a: Yes. Apply the second discount to the price after the first, or enter it directly as a flat coupon amount.
After. Discounts are applied first, then the flat coupon amount is subtracted from the discounted price (never below zero).
faqs.q: Is the coupon applied before or after the discount?

howto: Optionally add a second discount % or a flat coupon amount.
The final price and savings appear instantly.
title: Discount Calculator
